findings.defect: Replacing only native_driver in an otherwise acceptable future spec with the sealed orchestration JSON satisfies every driver-specific source guard. The binder hashes this JSON as the sole driver, though it is not driver.py. It does not authenticate exact driver.py or its sealed driver manifest/seal. No actual full binding was run.
findings.repair: Freeze and enforce the exact driver.py path and its registered seal/manifest binding, preserving current bytes.

findings.defect: The append-only fresh-root activation amendment is outside DRIVER_ROOT, so the only public controller-metadata binding field rejects it. The binder has no dedicated activation-amendment/actual-activation-record field. This is a concrete interface gap for direct authentication of the required supersession; external root authentication remains mandatory and can be implemented separately.
findings.repair: Before activation, add a separately registered activation binding or a separate registered root activation checker. Keep the sealed native019 source unchanged; require all actual prerequisites and exact fresh roots.

findings.defect: The registered schema prohibits extra top-level fields, but main/execute only hash the schema and read selected spec keys; they never validate the spec against it or compare its key set. An unused extra field does not affect any source guard. This is a closed-schema conformance gap, not evidence that qualification claims can be bypassed.
findings.repair: Enforce the complete closed binding schema or equivalent exact typed-key checks before imports or binding.
